title: Basra (Bastra)
turnYours: Your turn — pick a hand card, then tap table cards to capture (or none to trail).

hint.basra_sweep: Clear the table for a Basra bonus
hint.jack_sweep: Play a Jack to sweep the table
hint.capture: Capture the most valuable table cards
hint.trail_low: No capture — trail a low card

tutorial.table: These are the table cards. A number card you play captures table cards of the same rank and any set whose values add up to it; a Jack sweeps the whole table (except other Jacks). Clearing the table with a single non-Jack card scores a 'Basra' (+10).
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Pick one card, then tap the table cards you want to capture. Tap none and press Play to trail (leave your card on the table).
tutorial.playButton: Play the selected card. If you selected table cards, they are captured; otherwise the card trails.
tutorial.info: Basra (Bastra) is a 4-player (you + 3 CPU) fishing game on a 52-card deck. You are dealt four cards with four on the table; fresh hands are dealt until the stock is exhausted. Score the most cards, the 7♦, the 10♦, each Ace, and every Basra sweep. Highest total wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
